verdict.rationale: The evidence shows local models are reached through a CLI and through developer SDKs with chat APIs, not through a built-in graphical chat app. The only graphical chat surfaces mentioned are the console playground and the Mintlify 'Try it' page. Both run against the hosted production gateway, not local models, so they are adjacent at best and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can chat with local models using a built-in graphical chat interface
